story.text: 승객 여러분, 전주의 자랑, 천년 종이의 고장으로 안내해 드릴게요.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, jeon-ju-ui ja-rang, cheon-nyeon jong-i-ui go-jang-eu-ro an-nae-hae deu-ril-ge-yo.
story.en: Passengers, let me guide you to Jeonju's pride — the home of thousand-year paper.

story.text: 전주는 '한지'로 유명한 고장이에요. 천 년이 지나도 색이 바래지 않는 우리 전통 종이랍니다.
story.reading: jeon-ju-neun han-ji-ro yu-myeong-han go-jang-i-e-yo. cheon nyeon-i ji-na-do saeg-i ba-rae-ji an-neun u-ri jeon-tong jong-i-ram-ni-da.
story.en: Jeonju is famous for 'hanji'. It's our traditional paper that doesn't fade in color even after a thousand years.

story.text: 한지는 '닥나무'라는 나무의 껍질로 만들어요. 껍질을 삶고 두드려서 고운 종이로 다시 태어나지요.
story.reading: han-ji-neun dak-na-mu-ra-neun na-mu-ui kkeob-jil-lo man-deul-eo-yo. kkeob-jil-eul salm-go du-deu-ryeo-seo go-un jong-i-ro da-si tae-eo-na-ji-yo.
story.en: Hanji is made from the bark of a tree called 'paper mulberry'. The bark is boiled and beaten, then reborn as fine paper.

story.text: 옛날에는 방문에 '창호지'를 발랐어요. 은은한 햇빛이 종이를 통과해 방 안을 따뜻하게 밝혀 주었답니다.
story.reading: yen-nal-e-neun bang-mun-e chang-ho-ji-reul bal-la-sseo-yo. eun-eun-han haet-bich-i jong-i-reul tong-gwa-hae bang an-eul tta-tteut-ha-ge balk-hyeo ju-eot-dam-ni-da.
story.en: In the old days, 'window paper' was pasted onto room doors. Soft sunlight would pass through the paper and warmly light up the room.

story.text: 한지 위에는 '먹'으로 글씨를 썼어요. 벼루에 먹을 갈면 은은한 향과 검은 먹물이 나온답니다.
story.reading: han-ji wi-e-neun meog-eu-ro geul-ssi-reul sseo-sseo-yo. byeo-ru-e meog-eul gal-myeon eun-eun-han hyang-gwa geom-eun meok-mul-i na-o-ndam-ni-da.
story.en: On hanji, people wrote with 'ink sticks'. Grinding the ink stick on an inkstone releases a soft scent and black ink.

story.text: 한지는 '부채'로도 만들어져요. 여름이면 한지 부채를 부치며 더위를 식혔지요.
story.reading: han-ji-neun bu-chae-ro-do man-deul-eo-jyeo-yo. yeo-reum-i-myeon han-ji bu-chae-reul bu-chi-myeo deo-wi-reul sik-hyeot-ji-yo.
story.en: Hanji is also made into 'fans'. In summer, people cooled off by fanning themselves with hanji fans.

story.text: 자, 천년의 종이 한지를 오늘 다섯 단어로 만나 보았어요. 이제 문제를 풀며 실력을 펼쳐볼까요?
story.reading: ja, cheon-nyeon-ui jong-i han-ji-reul o-neul da-seot dan-eo-ro man-na bo-a-sseo-yo. i-je mun-je-reul pul-myeo sil-lyeog-eul pyeol-chyeo-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: Now, you've met thousand-year-old hanji through five words today. Shall we spread out your skills by solving some questions?

words.example_en: Hanji is our country's traditional paper.
Hanji is made from paper mulberry trees.
Window paper is paper pasted onto doors.
Fans are also made with hanji.
You write on hanji using an ink stick.

sentences.ko: 한지는 천 년이 지나도 변하지 않아요.
sentences.reading: han-ji-neun cheon nyeon-i ji-na-do byeon-ha-ji an-a-yo
sentences.en: Hanji doesn't change even after a thousand years.
Hanji is made from paper mulberry bark.
Window paper softly lights up the room.
A picture is drawn onto the fan.
You grind the ink stick and write with it.
